name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands
description: Dev-time minimal functional stand-in for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed type surface (CommandDefinition / CommandInvocation / CommandResult / CommandDescriptor / ParsedCommand, CommandId) and just enough runtime for real-composition tests (name normalization, flat global registry, handler execution via parseCommand). Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
